'''Slillek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was a member of the [[Hiironi irstat]] and in circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Slillek was assigned to guide the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to Cularin's [[Ishkik caverns]]. En route, they discovered some [[Death/Legends|deceased]] Tarasin hunters and were attacked by members of the [[Rock Rogues]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group. The party subsequently encountered a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Koll Jovas]], and they eventually made it to the caverns.
